title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - Journey
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/Journey. Trip that has been made by a waste collection vehicle in reality, following an itinerary, to collect waste from collection points and take it to a waste processing site. Subclass of saref:FeatureOfInterest directly (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.2.1.4); no location (not a geo:Feature, unlike Itinerary/RoadSegment).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Journey'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

followsItinerary.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/followsItinerary'. A journey follows a defined itinerary. Links to an Itinerary entity.

isMadeBy.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/isMadeBy'. A journey is made by one waste collection vehicle. Links to a WasteCollectionVehicle entity.

isMadeOn.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/isMadeOn'. A journey is made on a given date. (ontology restriction: maximum 1).

length.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/Length'. Length in distance of a journey or an itinerary. Unit: km.

duration.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/Duration'. Duration in time of a journey. Unit: seconds; not fixed by the ontology.
